verdict.rationale: UKVI documents a route for individuals to see the personal information it holds about them. This is a first-party way to obtain a copy of your data, though it reads as a request process rather than a self-serve export. Nothing indicates the format, whether it covers all data, or that it is machine-readable, and 'leaving' a government immigration authority has no real equivalent. Missing for 10: self-serve bulk export, documented open/machine-readable formats, confirmation of complete data coverage, independent or hands-on corroboration.
